nintendo - amiibo - noir dedede & hydra.name: Nintendo - amiibo - Noir Dedede & Hydra - Kirby Air Riders Series - Multi
nintendo - amiibo - noir dedede & hydra.description: Zorah’s granted wish finally set free. A lone warrior focused on a lonely mission. In the Kirby Air Riders game, Noir Dedede and others can ride machines like the Hydra: a legendary Air Ride Machine that rampages across the land as the vicious avatar of destruction. In the Kirby Air Riders game, place this Noir Dedede amiibo figure on the Hydra amiibo to create a Rider & Air Ride Machine combo. Tap the amiibo to train it up as a FP (Figure Player), which will gain FP levels and machine proficiency. If you have another Air Ride Machine amiibo, you can place Noir Dedede amiibo onto the other machine to create a new Rider & Air Ride Machine combo and earn machine proficiency. Noir Dedede will retain FP levels when placed and tapped with a different machine.
